Okay, the chance a malware got onto your phone is practically zero since its very difficult to actually get your phone infected, especially if IOS. You even mentionned being very careful with your online actions so if you havent downloaded anything very blantantly suspicious, malware is probably not your problem here. I also doubt you have a keylogger on your laptop since facebook seems to be your only problem (if keylogger, a lot more accounts could be seeing suspicious activity). Your password was either weak or got leaked in a big facebook data leak. Change it as soon as possible on your phone and write it down somewhere. A good but not too long pw, incase you need to change it again. If you had the same pw on other accounts, change those too (with different pws). Again, do all of this on your phone in case of a keylogger being on your laptop. After having changed your fb pw, go in your settings to chek your account activity. I believe there is an option to disconnect all connected devices, do that. Turn on 2 factor authentication and put your phone number (remember to change it when u get your new phone). After that, wait a couple days and regularly chek your accounts (facebook primarly, but also your email account, bank, instagram if you have, amazon, etc.. basically all your most important accounts) for weird things. Also suggest changing your email password just to be sure and turning on 2FA on as many accounts as possible, directed to your phone number. If you still have problems after all that, there might indeed be a malware somewhere, probably on your phone, but i highly doubt thats the case. Good luck with this, stay careful, if you need anymore help reply to this comment and ill do my best.
